intervals.label: detector manufacture and H-line construction
intervals.note: Start is the manufacture of the tracking detectors (2017), a lower bound; the H line was reported complete by March 2022 (arXiv:2203.07089).
intervals.quote: Four tracking detectors have been manufactured in 2017

intervals.label: commissioning (last dated status: March 2022)
intervals.note: As of March 2022 DeeMe planned to begin commissioning in April 2022 and initial physics runs in June 2022. No later source was found, so the present status is uncertain; no physics result has been found.
intervals.quote: The H-line construction has been completed and it will become ready for commissioning in January 2022.

placements.note: MLF building centroid (campus-grade); the H-line experimental area is not located in a fetched source.
placements.quote: The DeeMe experiment is planned to search for muon-to-electron conversion at J-PARC MLF.

summary.plain: A magnet with four layers of wire chambers that measures the momentum of electrons coming from the muon target, looking for one with the energy expected from muon-to-electron conversion.
summary.technical: H-line spectrometer with a 110 msr acceptance, dipole magnet and four high-voltage-switched MWPCs with FADC readout; electrons of 105 MeV/c from a graphite target.

technology.quote: a compact magnetic spectrometer, consisting of a dipole magnet and four sets of multiwire proportional chambers (MWPCs), are located to detect the electron, and measure its momentum.
technology.value: Compact magnetic spectrometer of a dipole magnet and four sets of multiwire proportional chambers
